operator_instruction.text: Score all 126c/126b/126a stimuli with SongEval (MuQ-large backbone, 5 aesthetic dims), run Part B clean-detune-control and karaoke-LUFS comparison, analyze win/tie/lose pass rates against preregistered criteria.

launch_authorization.scope: SongEval scoring (5 dims: se_coh/se_mem/se_nat/se_cla/se_mus) of 126c (36,366 FLACs), 126b (87,653 FLACs), 126a (53 variants × 5 systems × 5,131 clips generated on-the-fly from R115 + transform), Part B1 (detune control: rubberband +50c/-50c vs +100c/-50c vs +100c/-100c on MUSDB vocals), Part B2 (karaoke 12 songs at -30 LUFS vs original LUFS, demucs removal deltas); win/tie/lose analysis against m=0.10*S threshold; S_i = range of clean means across 5 TTM systems; pass=80%; NVMe peak < 500 MB extra; wall time < 10.5 h. No generation, no training.

question: Does SongEval (trained on musicality judgements of AI-generated songs) pass the two-criteria requirement — detect clearly-worse edits (lose) and judge tie on unimportant differences — in the same cases where AES/MEva/CLAP/MIR all failed?

fixed_protocol.stimuli_126a: generated on-the-fly: R115/{system}/lvl30/audio/{id}.flac → transform → 24kHz; 5131 clips × 53 variants × 5 systems
fixed_protocol.songeval: ASLP-lab/SongEval commit 848fb2ff3a2a9d64dcb20d46f07238c28abd7add; ckpt sha256 0cb1eb8be02b96e9949ca3a2b66997c5ac7d9da3567240df4dbfc2048eb98efd; MuQ revision 0562a57814f6f8bbd9fdea0a25921a2fce1a841a
fixed_protocol.scoring: 24kHz input (librosa.resample), batch_size=16, deterministic (same clip scored twice: diff=0.00e+00), batch sensitivity bs=1 vs bs=16: 1.41e-4 (acceptable)
fixed_protocol.judgment: d = score(case) - score(clean_base, same clip or window); tie if |d| <= m, m = 0.10*S_i; S_i = max_sys(mean_i) - min_sys(mean_i) for i in {coh,mem,nat,cla,mus}; pass = 80% of pairs; S computed from Part A-3 clean unit results
fixed_protocol.identity_gate: rescore ~200 126b clips with AES PQ, compare to stored scores.tsv; max allowed diff 1e-3

resume.note: TSV-level autoresume: if 126c_songeval.tsv / 126b_songeval.tsv already exist and have the right number of rows, skip those parts; 126a unit-level: if {vname}/{system}/songeval.tsv exists with correct rows, skip

completion_evidence.method: guest writes terminal with sha256 of the registered summary after --validate-only passes
